events.body:
## Context

`worker/refresh.js` (about L37-44) counts `payload.commits.length` and reads `payload.commits[0].message`. The committed `public/data/github-contributions.json` has 20 commit entries but `stats.commits` is 0 and every description is "Code changes", which matches GitHub trimming PushEvent payloads. Check the current Events API docs before relying on this.

## What to do

1. Count PushEvents (or use whatever size field the current payload has) and fall back gracefully.
2. Add a test fixture with no `commits` array to `test/worker.test.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A PushEvent without `commits` increments a non-zero counter
- [ ] New and existing tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh my-gsoc-tool
```
